items.title: Submit vacation preference entries for Jan-June 2027
items.quote: Ihre Wünsche für den Urlaub im ersten Halbjahr tragen Sie bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum in die Liste ein; Arbeitstage sind Montag bis Freitag ohne Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) = 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), the triggering event. Following the standard rule that a period running 'ab' an event starts the day after that event (analogous to §187 BGB), counting of Arbeitstage begins on 19.11.2026 (Thursday). The letter itself defines 'Arbeitstage' as Monday-Friday excluding public holidays, so weekends are skipped and no NRW holidays fall in this window. Counting workdays: Day1=Thu 19.11, Day2=Fri 20.11 (Sat 21.11/Sun 22.11 skipped), Day3=Mon 23.11, Day4=Tue 24.11, Day5=Wed 25.11, Day6=Thu 26.11, Day7=Fri 27.11 (Sat 28.11/Sun 29.11 skipped), Day8=Mon 30.11, Day9=Tue 01.12, Day10=Wed 02.12.2026. No NRW public holiday falls between 19.11 and 02.12.2026, so the 10th working day, 02.12.2026, is the deadline.
